---
title: "GitHub data access"
description: "Read CSV resources from public or private GitHub repositories."
---

## Build a raw URL

```python
from metasalmonpy import github_raw_url

url = github_raw_url(
    "data/gold/dimension_tables/dim_date.csv",
    repo="dfo-pacific-science/qualark-data",
    ref="v0.3.0",
)
```

Pin `ref` to a tag or commit when reproducibility matters. The default is
`main`.

## Read one CSV

```python
from metasalmonpy import read_github_csv

dim_date = read_github_csv(
    "data/gold/dimension_tables/dim_date.csv",
    repo="dfo-pacific-science/qualark-data",
    ref="v0.3.0",
)
```

## Read a directory

```python
from metasalmonpy import read_github_csv_dir

tables = read_github_csv_dir(
    "data/gold/dimension_tables",
    repo="dfo-pacific-science/qualark-data",
    ref="v0.3.0",
)
```

## Private repositories

Token discovery checks `GITHUB_PAT`, `GH_TOKEN`, and the configured git
credential store. Verify discovery without printing the token:

```python
from metasalmonpy import ms_setup_github

ms_setup_github(repo="dfo-pacific-science/qualark-data")
```

Pass `token=` directly only when your application already manages credentials.
Do not commit tokens to source, examples, notebooks, or `.env` files that are
tracked by git.
